title: Crystal Palace host Manchester City in Friday night Premier League clash
summary: Crystal Palace welcome Manchester City to Selhurst Park on Friday at 19:00 UTC in a Premier League matchweek 2 fixture, with the Athletic's preview tabbing City eighth in the table after one match and Palace sixteenth. The match lands 24 hours before the Bundesliga opener and rounds out a full Friday of European top-flight football, with the new Premier League season already two matchdays old.
